description: J.K. Spinning Mills Limited is the listed spinning company of J.K. Group, incorporated in 1987 as Zeeshan Textile Mills Limited and renamed on 24 November 1994. It runs four spinning units with roughly 183,538 spindles and 6,000 rotors, spinning 100% cotton, PC, PP, PV and viscose yarns in counts from Ne 10s to 170s, with two-for-one twisting for two-fold yarns. The group's fabric division weaves, processes and stitches grey, bleached, dyed and printed fabric and home and institutional textiles.
headOffice: 29 KM, Sheikhupura Road, Khurrianwala, Faisalabad, Pakistan
